arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT card_id) AS cards_with_same_timestamp_pairs FROM (SELECT card_id, date FROM transactions GROUP BY card_id, date HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)
arguments.explanation: Counts the cards that have at least two transactions with exactly the same date and time.
assumptions: 'Exactly the same timestamp' means the same full date value. The data records it to the minute, so this means the same minute.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label, have an error, or have a negative amount.
